verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited automated multi-step workflows. Nothing in the evidence shows per-contact visibility into a person's position within a running automation, or any ability to remove or re-enter an individual contact without disrupting the flow. Workflow existence alone is an adjacent capability and does not cover this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
